page.layout: One page of text: running head top left, page number top right; heading centred below; one verse stanza in italic; a printed ornament (fleuron) in the middle below the poem; signature mark at lower right of the text block. No marginal notes. Faint show-through in the lower margins is not transcribed.

p.i: QVANTVS Doctor erat faber Tubingus, Antistes faber ille vbiquitatis, Liminúmque faber potentiorum Scurra: cui fuit inquieta semper Mens, & garrula lingua non diserta, Testatur modo quæ[?] cano capaci Vix totum est potis illius cadauer Moles Sarcophagi tenere, quanta Barro sufficeret, tribusve asellis, Qua lectica fuit minor Mathonis. Isthoc se grauius tulisse nunquam Iurant Sandapilarij cadauer. Tantus Doctor erat faber Tubingus!

page.notes: Line 6, "quæ", is partly covered by a smudge; the reading is doubtful. Line 3, "Liminúmque", the accent on the u is faint. Line 1, the Q is a decorative initial, set joined to VANTVS in capitals. Verse lines were run together into one stanza paragraph per the stanza rule; the printed line breaks are as follows: lines 1 to 13 as listed in the text. The ornament is not text and is not transcribed. Faint show-through in the lower margins is not transcribed.
